fields.Name: T100 - Message Actions On AI Message
fields.Description: Exercises MessageItemComponent footer controls (pin message, 'Rate response' 1–10 rating dialog) on a rendered message — a distinct per-message interaction path from send/compose.
fields.ExpectedOutcomes:
{
  "goalCompleted": true,
  "minConfidence": 0.7,
  "maxSteps": 35,
  "judgeValidationCriteria": [
    "The seeded AI reply shows its action row: 'Regenerate', 'Rate response' and a pin (thumbtack) button",
    "'Rate response' opens a 'Rate this response' dialog with a 1–10 numbered scale and a 'Tell us more' box, and Cancel closes it without submitting",
    "Clicking the pin button toggles it to the pinned state (highlight, 'Unpin message' tooltip and/or a thumbtack count chip in the header), and the thread layout stays intact",
    "No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages"
  ]
}
